title: Root and child AgentHost startup, readiness, and terminal cleanup
alt: The native .NET CLI discovers Environment operations from Gateway OpenAPI. The Gateway forwards authorized requests to the fixed Environment owner, which checks current authority and generation fences. Orchestrator records the root start or committed child spawn and its stable operation IDs before Environment provisions the placement. Environment checks current authority, selection, and fences, then creates a retained workspace and Sandbox. Orchestrator registers the runtime, requests Broker bootstrap, and activates the Host through Environment. Readiness requires current registration, placement, and Host evidence before child dispatch. Ready status returns verified runtime, model selection, image, and Pod fields without requiring a P1 claim. A child blocked after bootstrap delivery failure remains a cleanup obligation until terminal cleanup confirms retirement. Terminal cleanup checks native quiescence and cleans children before the root. Environment releases only the exact owned resource and retains workspace data. Unknown or unresolved calls remain pending.
